lead: Vermont plumbing is built for hard winters, old farmhouses and private wells. PipeMend sends licensed local plumbers across the state.
risk: frozen pipes, private wells and septic systems and storm flooding in river valleys
why: Many Vermont homes are old farmhouses and village homes with a mix of old and new pipe. Winters freeze pipes in exterior walls, crawl spaces and seasonal camps. Many homes heat with oil, propane or wood.
Most rural homes rely on private wells and septic systems. River valleys flood in heavy rain, as in July 2023. The Vermont Division of Fire Safety licenses plumbers.
tips: Keep the heat on in winter.
Test your sump pump before spring.
areas: Calls come from Burlington, South Burlington, Rutland, Montpelier, Barre, Brattleboro, the Northeast Kingdom and the ski towns.

faq.a: The Vermont Division of Fire Safety licenses plumbers. Check the license before work starts.
